Finding: No sign of spam protection in the HTML: no honeypot-style hidden field and no captcha or Turnstile script. Spam may still be filtered on the server, which this report cannot see.
Fix: Ask whoever runs the form where spam is filtered; if nowhere, add a honeypot field (hidden from people, bots fill it in) or a privacy-friendly challenge.
